QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_9

question.text: A Cat III global-macro fund reports AUM of INR 300 crore and monthly portfolio volatility of 3.5%. Compute the 99% 1-month parametric VaR (z = 2.33).

explanation.text: The Logic: VaR(99%, 1-month) = 2.33 × 3.5% × 300 cr = 2.33 × 10.50 cr = INR 24.465 cr ≈ INR 24.47 crore. Interpretation: 1% chance monthly loss exceeds INR 24.47 cr. The Trap: INR 10.50 cr is 1σ absolute. INR 17.29 cr is 95% z=1.645. INR 34.95 cr uses 3.33 σ. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/C Compliance tests VaR from a governance angle. XIX-E tests quantitative computation. Manager's Pro-Tip: On month-end, size down positions that push VaR near the PPM-disclosed VaR limit — avoid last-day trades that breach and trigger risk-committee escalation.
